messages:
PagerDutyBot: HIGH alert — inference-prod / us-east. 5xx rate 15% over 5m, p95 latency doubled. Paging @Dan (oncall-sre).

Dan (oncall-sre): on it. I see the spike, dashboards loading. Correlating with provider A tail errors. Adding @Maya.

Maya (sre-lead): real-time quick check: provider A nodes show increased socket errors, provider A health flags flapping. Our edge proxies showing ~12% dropped connections to provider A. Customer impact: elevated 500s for hosted API, especially free tier and embeddings.

Dan (oncall-sre): triage notes: spike started 12:08 UTC, coincides with a provider A rollout? Jorge, any infra noise from providers?

Jorge (infra): confirmed — provider A reported maintenance in us-east starting ~12:00 but said no impact. We're seeing TCP resets from a subset of AZs. Provider fallback path (provider B) healthy.

Dan (oncall-sre): plan: (1) immediate soft quota shift to reduce retries and surface backpressure (2) route new traffic from provider A -> provider B for compatible models (3) partial brownout for non-paying embeddings and experimental features to reduce load. Maya take lead on routing. I'll enact quota shift.

Maya (sre-lead): I’ll start a staged provider reroute. Doing a 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% ramp over 10m windows. Will monitor p95 and error rate. If error rate on provider B remains <3%, continue.

Dan (oncall-sre): executing quota change now:
```
# infra ctl
infra quota update --scope=hosted-api --tier=free --max-qps=5 --reason="live mitigation: provider A instability"
infra quota update --scope=hosted-api --tier=selfserve --max-qps=10 --reason="live mitigation"
```

OpsBot: Quotas updated: free tier max-qps=5; selfserve max-qps=10. Changes applied to edge-control plane (propagation 20s).

Nina (cs): flagging top 5 customers on free/self-serve embeddings. I'll prepare a brief PS message if we decide to brownout embeddings. Any ETA?

Dan (oncall-sre): ETA for brownout decision 10m after first ramp. Initial traffic to provider B at +12:14 (10%).

Maya (sre-lead): ramp log: 12:14 -> 10% to provider B. Error rate for hosted-api dropped from 15% -> 9%. Latency p95 slightly improved. Continuing to 30%.

Jorge (infra): note: KV cache miss rate increased on provider B because models are landing on different backends — expect some cold-start latency for large models. We can apply prefix-KV warmers if needed.

Dan (oncall-sre): enable model-level fallback to quantized variant for non-enterprise tenants to reduce memory churn. Command:
```
# runtime ctl
runtime rollout set-policy --model-prefix=gpt-*-open --policy=fallback-quantized --scope=tier:free,selfserve
```

OpsBot: Rollout policy queued, will start at 12:20 UTC with canary 5%.

Maya (sre-lead): at 12:18 -> ramp to 30% provider B: error rate now 6.5%, p95 trending down. Plan to 60%.

Dan (oncall-sre): initiating partial brownout for embeddings on free tier: disable embeddings endpoint for free accounts and throttle self-serve to 0.5 r/s per IP. Priya please coordinate the product flags.

Priya (prod-ops): toggling feature flags: embeddings.free.enabled = false; embeddings.selfserve.qps = 0.5. Pushing flag change now.

OpsBot: Feature flags updated: embeddings.free.enabled=false; embeddings.selfserve.qps=0.5. Change will take effect within 30s.

Nina (cs): prepping customer comms: short advisory + support playbook. Draft: "We're seeing partial provider outages; we've rerouted traffic and temporarily limited embeddings for free/self-serve tiers to maintain service for paid customers. We'll update in 30m." Want approval?

Dan (oncall-sre): yes, send. Add note: recommendation for customers to retry with exponential backoff and lower max-tokens for now.

Maya (sre-lead): ramp to 60% at 12:24 -> provider B. Error rate now 3.1% system-wide. p95 back to baseline for most routes. Holding for two windows before 100%.

Jorge (infra): doing a targeted cache warming for the top 20 model shards to reduce latency on provider B. Script running:
```
# cache warmer
for shard in $(cat top-shards); do warm --shard $shard --target=providerB ; done
```

Dan (oncall-sre): update on customer impact: 3rd-party monitoring shows 18 customers saw elevated 500s between 12:08-12:18. Post-mitigation errors dropped to background. No SEV page required yet but CS escalation likely for a few accounts.

Nina (cs): I've opened three high-touch tickets and notified AMs for the affected customers. Sending advisory now.

OpsBot: Advisory posted to status.redwood.example.com: "Partial disruption affecting hosted-api in us-east. Mitigations in progress. Some free/self-serve features temporarily limited."

Maya (sre-lead): at 12:34 ramp to 100% to provider B. Monitoring: system error 1.6%, p95 stable. Observability shows provider A errors continue in subset of AZs.

Dan (oncall-sre): good. Next steps: (A) keep quotas reduced for 30m; (B) keep embeddings brownout until provider A declares healthy or for 1h; (C) collect post-incident telemetry and run a regression test for routing logic. Assigning postmortem to Maya + Dan.

Priya (prod-ops): toggling internal alert to watch for regressions when we revert flags. Will create a revert-playbook with steps and guardrails.

Jorge (infra): filing provider incident ticket with provider A with our logs + packet captures.

Dan (oncall-sre): handing off to Maya for steady-state monitoring. I'm out for the rotation at 13:00. Maya please take lead on postmortem details.

Maya (sre-lead): acknowledged. I'll keep the channel in steady-state check. Will start timeline and capture commands used. Dan thanks.

PagerDutyBot: Incident acknowledged by Dan (oncall-sre) at 12:10 UTC, escalated to SRE lead at 12:12 UTC.

Dan (oncall-sre): thanks everyone. Closing active mitigations summary: provider reroute -> provider B completed, quotas reduced for free/self-serve, embeddings brownout enabled for free tier, rollout policy for fallback quantized variants queued. I'll update the incident ticket with the timeline.

Maya (sre-lead): will draft postmortem and share within 24h. Leaving channel for monitoring window — ping if errors spike. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Monitoring watch set for 60 minutes. Alerts will escalate to oncall if system error rate >5% for 5m.

Nina (cs): will follow up with customers and close the high-touch tickets once metrics stabilize.

Dan (oncall-sre): final note: keep throttles conservative until provider A fully clears — gradual rollback only.

Maya (sre-lead): copying the key commands to the incident ticket so runbook is reproducible.

PagerDutyBot: Incident resolved? Manual close pending postmortem.

Dan (oncall-sre): marking mitigations stable. Last check-in 12:59 UTC.

Maya (sre-lead): 12:59 -> switching to watch-only. Will update ticket with RCA and action items.

OpsBot: Thread archived for audit."
